name: Stream & Watershed Enhancement Grant
summary: Mini-grants for local watershed groups, non-profits and local governments in the Susquehanna River Basin to improve, restore or protect local waterways.

eligibility.rule: Project is in the Susquehanna River Basin and tied to its waters, protective lands or communities
Watershed group (officers and bylaws if unincorporated), school, nonprofit/501(c)(3), or municipal or county government
No regulatory, permitting, land development, lobbying, litigation, financing, illegal, personal or application costs
Receives no more than one award per organization

status.quote: The grant opens September 15, 2026 and closes October 30, 2026.

opens.quote: The grant opens September 15, 2026 and closes October 30, 2026.

deadline.quote: The grant opens September 15, 2026 and closes October 30, 2026.

applicant_types.quote: Watershed group - if unincorporated, must be organized with officers and bylaws Educational program or school district Non-profit/501c(3) or equivalent Municipal or County Governments

geography.quote: All projects must be within the Susquehanna River Basin

window.quote: The grant opens September 15, 2026 and closes October 30, 2026.

amount.quote: Mini grants are awarded up to $5,000 per selected projects.

co_finance_required.quote: No, matching funds are not required for this grant.

effort.quote: The grant application opens September 15, 2026, and closes October 30, 2026.

eligibility.quote: All projects must be within the Susquehanna River Basin and have significant ties to the water resources of the Basin, the lands that protect the Basin's waters, and/or the communities tied to both.
Watershed group - if unincorporated, must be organized with officers and bylaws Educational program or school district Non-profit/501c(3) or equivalent Municipal or County Governments

Ineligible costs include routine regulatory obligations, permitting, land development projects, lobbying, litigation, fees for securing other financing or associated with bad debts, interest on borrowed funds, illegal activities or substances, costs associated with personal expenses of board members and/or officers/staff, application preparation fees
Yes, awards are limited to one per organization.

after_award.quote: The Grantee or any other person representing the Grantee shall allow authorized employees or agents of the Commission, without advance notice, at any reasonable time and upon presentation of appropriate credentials, and without delay, to have access to all areas where the project occurs.
